LIST: Get ready for The Big E Fair’s 2025 food lineup · The Big E Fair is the largest event on the East Coast and the fourth-largest fair in North America, but how much does it cost to get in?

If you plan to go to The Big E multiple times, there is a value pass option that gets you in daily during the 17 days of the fair for $71.50 per adult and $36.50 for children ages 6 through 12. For $33.50, you can also get one wristband that includes unlimited rides at the Midway on the day you visit, Monday through Friday, or 78 credits on Saturday or Sunday. If you plan to park on the Big E fairgrounds, all main parking will be found at Gate 9, which is the first gate on Memorial Avenue if you are coming from the east (from Springfield, Route 5, I-91, etc.) and the last gate if coming from the west (Agawam).

Motorcycles can park for $5 at Gate 9.
